mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dimension_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} AND receiver_id = #{peerId}) OR (sender_id = #{peerId} AND receiver_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}

SELECT t.*, x.peer_id AS peerId, u.nickname AS peerNickname, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_message m2 WHERE m2.sender_id = x.peer_id AND m2.receiver_id = #{userId} AND m2.is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS peer_id, MAX(id) AS last_id FROM dimension_message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY peer_id ) x INNER JOIN dimension_message t ON t.id = x.last_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = x.peer_id ORDER BY t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dimension_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_id = #{fromId} AND receiver_id = #{toId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
